rationale: Enumerated all feasible battery dispatch schedules (respecting 2MW step resolution and power/SOC limits). Selected the dispatch that minimizes diesel generation cost. The optimal strategy charges the battery during t1 (low load, sufficient PV+diesel capacity) and discharges it during t3 (high PV, low load) to minimize expensive diesel generation. This achieves the minimum cost of $9435 by dispatching 111 MWh of diesel energy at $85/MWh.
